Let <MATH_0001> be a category cofibered in groupoids over
<MATH_0002>. Consider the following conditions
<STRUCT_0001>
<STRUCT_0002> <MATH_0003> admits a presentation by a normalized
smooth prorepresentable groupoid in functors on <MATH_0004>,
<STRUCT_0003> <MATH_0005> admits a presentation by a
smooth prorepresentable groupoid in functors on <MATH_0006>,
<STRUCT_0004> <MATH_0007> admits a presentation by a minimal
smooth prorepresentable groupoid in functors on <MATH_0008>, and
<STRUCT_0005> <MATH_0009> satisfies the following conditions
<STRUCT_0006>
<STRUCT_0007> <MATH_0010> is a deformation category.
<STRUCT_0008> <MATH_0011> is finite.
<STRUCT_0009> <MATH_0012> is finite.
<STRUCT_0010>
<STRUCT_0011>
Then (2), (3), (4) are equivalent and are implied by (1).
If <MATH_0013> is separable, then (1), (2), (3), (4) are all equivalent.
Furthermore, the minimal smooth prorepresentable groupoids in functors
which provide a presentation of <MATH_0014> are unique up to isomorphism.
